purpose: Concrete AgentProof and Proofline project guardrail scope

state.goal: Apply actual AgentProof, Proofline and MightShape guardrails to SUNNY, with Jev directing choices.
state.facts: AgentProof can capture only a NEW Codex CLI child session. It requires a trusted Git root, read-only or workspace-write scope, max20MiBfile/100MiBtotal, and cannot prove truth/completeness or capture this chat. SUNNYworkspace has generated2GBdatabase and1.2GBmodel; upstream pinnedruntime is a separateGit repo. Root source files small. Real user instruction and live Jev receipts exist. Proofline schema requires confidence numeric; no research confidence should be invented.
state.constraints: No private logs uploaded to external model, no signing/anchoring, no bypassing profile checks, no retroactive Jev authorship claim. Capture's CLI model is writer/executor only; Jev remains decision authority.

questions.question: Which concrete AgentProof guardrail scope should execute now?

options.source_review_repo: Create a clearly scoped local review Git repository containing exact copies+hashes of SUNNY source/tool files, then capture a new read-only child that verifies those hashes and runs predetermined checks without making domain decisions.
options.upstream_runtime: Capture a new read-only child in the pinned upstream runtimeGit repository, verifying runtime source/hash manifests only; keep its narrow scope explicit.
options.defer_capture: Leave capture unexecuted and only document the current-session limitation until full SUNNY integration is finished.

questions.question: What project-specific claim can Proofline verify without inventing mathematical confidence?

options.integrity_only: Package the concrete engineering decision to require actual live Jev gates, citing exact user instruction bytes and actual tool/model/receipt versions; state deterministic source-integrity confidence separately from unknown research correctness.
options.domain_confidence: Assign a numeric confidence to the complete SUNNY musical law despite no held-out results.
options.fixture_only: Execute only the packaged synthetic fixture and leave project provenance unverified.
